race.comment: BOTANICAL BOY (8) has been honest in two runs back in Victoria and was chopped out at a key moment last start, which cost him a much closer finish. He should be hitting his stride now and Lloyd going on is a strong push. MR MILLER (2) looks a progressive type who justified a short quote fresh and should be even better as he gets out over more ground. STEEL STRIKE (5) has returned in good order and Clark can roll across from the wide draw to give him every chance to make his presence felt. STAGNUM (11) risks landing in a sticky spot from the low draw if Schiller isn't proactive early, so he'll be hoping they overdo it up front so he can pounce late. CUBAN CIGAR (6) is another who needs a hot tempo to launch but he has the engine to make things interesting late.
